additional_info.subject: ID0456240-DC/Si-D/MY- [MP / ND 170000121] Connector 1 unable to use CRM:02832000632
additional_info.body:
Hello Ines, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I apologise, my colleague left this ticket without a response.
We see that this charger has a problem during voltage raise in PreCharge. As such, please perform these troubleshooting steps and provide a solution based on the guide:
The first step is to troubleshoot the voltage transducer TF1. Please try swapping TF1 with TF2 (all connections and position) and try again a session.
If it works, then most likely the TF1 is faulty and needs replacement, if you re-swap again and it fails, replace the TF1.
Otherwise please check this connector:
What can happen is that the female and male part are not attached properly, e.g:
2nd is to troubleshoot if the contactor is closing properly or not:
When during charge, in PreCharge, we need to measure after QA21-22 and see if the voltage from TF5 is the same as after QA21-22. You need to measure this with crocodile tips as it's very dangerous to measure directly.
Turn off charger -> connect probes -> stay back -> read the measurements.
If not, then the contactor is not closing properly and needs replacement.
The charger is already out of warranty so please discuss with the customer on how to proceed. The MLFB for contactor and TF1:
8EM5903-0AA00-7AA8 - contactor x2
8EM5903-0AA01-0AA5 - TF1
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
